values.task_boundary: Review and report on exactly one immutable successor planning revision; make no planning or product changes.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Review binds the exact merged planning revision and records scope and dirt state
AC-2: The denominator covers all canonical v0.92.2 planning and feature-routing surfaces
AC-3: Review checks scope, dependencies, one-result units, deferrals, closeout order, operator gates, and non-claims
AC-4: Every finding has severity, evidence, owner, and disposition
AC-5: Any post-review planning change invalidates the result; actionable findings route to #523 or #524 and require a fresh #525 review before #526
AC-6: The final report distinguishes validator results from semantic review judgment
